name: Boone County, IL
fy_label_rule: fiscal year runs December 1 to November 30 and is named for the year it ends (FY2026 = December 1, 2025 to November 30, 2026); audits are 'for the year ended November 30'
scope_note: County government only (decision 2026-10-31). The Circuit Clerk's separate audits, the Health Department and other units are out of scope.

account_format.pattern: FFF-DDDD-OOOOOO in the FY2026 budget (fund-department-object, e.g. 001-0000-301000); earlier layouts to be established when each year is read
account_format.key_note: provisional until the budgets FY2017-FY2025 are read
